notes: Page is headed AMBIRAD-Nordyne and lists Nordyne among sister/similar brands, but its documented styles are NOT identical to the Nordyne file's styles: style-1 here matches Nordyne style-1 (same shape, positions, and example GBB030708229), while the page's styles 2-5 have no counterpart in the Nordyne file (whose style-2 is a 16-character system absent from this page). usesStylesOf is therefore not used; all styles below are transcribed from this page. Page styles 3, 4 (first), and 4 (second) collapse to ONE normalized style (letter-digit-letter + 9 digits, year [3,5], month [5,7]). COORDINATOR CORRECTION (Wave 3): page Style 2 (F3891 4228) NOW SHIPPED as 1989, superseding the Wave 1/2 hold. The digit-counting reading (91 -> 1991) is falsified by this page's own examples: under digit-only counting, style 1's example GBB030708229 would give year 70 and month 82 (not a month), and the E2E style example would give year 50 (1950, below the 1960 floor). Character counting is therefore this page's unique coherent convention, and it decodes every example on the page. The Nordyne file's 16-character style is a different system on a different page and does not govern this page's convention. The NORDYNE-2 diagram read is no longer the unblocker for this style (it remains a welcome confirmation). The same correction ships on the Benson, Ambirad, and Airbloc pages.

styles.notes: Page positions 4-5 = year, 6-7 = month (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Page example shown as GBB030708229.

styles.era: 9-character serials, 1 letter followed by 8 digits (page Style 2)
styles.notes: Page Style 2 example shown as F3891 4228 (space not counted). Year = 3rd & 4th characters (1-based) = [2,4] on the normalized serial -> 1989. See file notes for why character counting is this page's convention: digit-only counting is falsified by the page's own style-1 and E2E-style examples.

styles.era: 12-character serials, letter-digit-letter followed by 9 digits (page styles 3, 4, and second 4 merged)
styles.notes: Page style 3 example shown as G6R9905-05028; page style 4 example shown with spaces as M 1 G 9807 - 05432; second page style 4 example shown as E2E-9705 01234. All three normalize to letter-digit-letter plus 9 digits and decode under the same ranges: year = 4th-5th characters, month = 6th-7th characters (1-based) on the normalized serial. For the E2E example the page's stated 5th-6th/7th-8th positions count the dash on the raw serial; after normalization they are the same [3,5]/[5,7] ranges used here.
